data.markdown:
About Us
========

Pan-Latin Cuisine & Cocktails in Wicker Park
--------------------------------------------

At Amaru, we share our culture, history and passion for Latin American food and warm hospitality with you. We have multinational influences from the Argentinian wine country to the seafood-abundant waters of Peru; the Amazonian jungles of Brazil to the verdant mountains of Colombia; with the diversity of Mexico and the spirit of the Caribbean.

[Read more about us](https://amaruchicago.com/chicago-wicker-park-amaru-about#)

Order Online
============

Savor Convenience, Savor Delight
--------------------------------

Enjoy gourmet delights delivered straight to your doorstep with our simple online ordering system. Satisfy your cravings with ease and convenience.

Catering
========

Elevate Your Event with Culinary Creativity
-------------------------------------------

Transform your event with our imaginative and diverse menu selections. We bring culinary artistry and a touch of elegance to every gathering.

Reviews
=======

Review by - Google
------------------

### five star review by Michael L:

> Wow! What a great dining experience. Food was delicious, so many flavors. Small to medium plates so great for sharing, we had 9 different plates plus dessert, sated beyond belief!

Review by - Google
------------------

### five star review by Henna J:

> Every single thing we tried was absolutely delicious. Perfect service. Calm and enjoyable atmosphere. Looking forward to coming back again and trying more items from the menu!
